svg.title: Instagram Highlight Downloader – Architecture
svg.desc: Two-version architecture: V1 downloads highlights into organized folders, V2 stitches them into a video

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How should I validate Instagram usernames?')
sendPrompt('How does instaloader fetch Instagram highlights?')
sendPrompt('How do I parse highlight metadata with instaloader?')
sendPrompt('How should I download videos and images from highlights?')
sendPrompt('What folder structure should I use for highlights?')
sendPrompt('How do I stitch highlight slides into a single video with ffmpeg?')
sendPrompt('What output format should the stitched highlight video use?')

svg.text: → v3: wrap in a website or iOS app, add payments / ads
